mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_org_position_assignment (id, workspace_id, directory_id, position_id, engagement_id, unit_assignment_id, org_unit_id, kind, valid_from, valid_until, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{directoryId}, #{positionId}, #{engagementId}, #{unitAssignmentId}, #{orgUnitId}, #{kind}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
